title: Remote Interior Design CAD Drafter
description:

We are seeking a detail-oriented Remote Interior Design CAD Drafter to support our design team by producing accurate, high-quality interior construction drawings and documentation. • Prepare and revise interior construction drawings in AutoCAD.

• Produce floor plans, reflected ceiling plans, elevations, sections, schedules, and interior details.

• Translate designer sketches, markups, and specifications into clear technical drawings.

• Incorporate architectural, consultant, and field information into drawing sets.

• Maintain consistent drafting standards, layers, annotations, dimensions, and file organization.

• Coordinate drawings to identify inconsistencies or missing information.

• Update drawing sets throughout the design and construction process.

• Assist with drawing packages for client review, pricing, permitting, and construction.

• Communicate questions and potential conflicts to the project designer or senior drafter.

• Manage multiple projects and meet established deadlines.

• Perform other duties related to the position as assigned.

• Proficient level of English (written and spoken).

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

• 3-5 years of CAD drafting experience, preferably in interior design.

• Proficiency in AutoCAD and SketchUp is required; familiarity of Revit is preferred.

• Experience producing interior design or architectural construction documents.

• Working knowledge of interior construction, materials, finishes, cabinetry, and basic millwork.

• Ability to read and interpret architectural plans and consultant drawings.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

• Strong organization, time management, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to follow established drafting standards and direction.

• Degree or technical training in interior design, architecture, drafting, or a related field is preferred.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and deadline-driven environment.

• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and follow established processes.

• Quick learner with the ability to adapt to new systems and workflows.

• Professional, dependable, coachable, and accountable with excellent attendance.

• Creative, resourceful, and proactive with an out-of-the-box mindset.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook), and standard business tools (email, spreadsheets, document management).

• Ability to work U.S. Eastern Time (New York) business hours and adapt to business needs.

• Interested in long-term career opportunities.

• Reliable computer (Windows 10 or newer), two monitors, and stable high-speed internet.﻿

• Professional home workstation capable of supporting uninterrupted remote work.

Compensation & Benefits:

• 100% remote work.

title: Industrial Designer
description:
About Menlo

Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable -- turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.
The Role
Industrial design at Menlo is not cosmetic. Asimov is a physical product that will be assembled, operated, serviced, and iterated on -- and how it looks and feels in the world is as consequential as how it performs. As our Industrial Designer, you will own the form language and physical identity of Asimov, from enclosures and surface treatments to ergonomics, CMF (color, material, finish), and packaging. You will work shoulder to shoulder with mechanical and electrical engineers to ensure that every design decision holds up in manufacturing and survives contact with real-world conditions.
What You Will Do

• Develop the industrial design vision for Asimov and Menlo hardware products, including form, proportion, ergonomics, and CMF

• Translate engineering constraints and functional requirements into design concepts that are both manufacturable and visually coherent

• Produce high-fidelity 3D models, renderings, and physical prototypes to communicate and test design intent

• Partner with mechanical engineering on DFM (design for manufacturing) reviews, tolerance stack-ups, and assembly sequencing to catch design issues before tooling

• Own the CMF specification process -- material selection, surface finish standards, color systems, and supplier engagement

• Contribute to user-facing documentation, packaging, and unboxing experience for Asimov kits and development hardware

• Maintain design consistency across the Menlo hardware product family as the portfolio expands

What You Will Bring

• Degree in Industrial Design, Product Design, or a related discipline

• 4 or more years of experience shipping physical products -- consumer electronics, robotics, medical devices, or similarly complex hardware

• Strong proficiency in 3D modeling tools (Alias, Rhino, SolidWorks, or equivalent) and rendering software (KeyShot or similar)

• Working knowledge of manufacturing processes: injection molding, sheet metal, die casting, surface finishing

• Experience collaborating directly with mechanical engineers and contract manufacturers in an iterative development environment

• Portfolio demonstrating a consistent design sensibility applied to technically constrained products

Nice to Have

• Experience designing for humanoid or legged robots, cobots, or other electromechanical systems

• Exposure to DFM/DFA review processes in a high-mix low-volume manufacturing context

• Familiarity with sim or CAD-driven design workflows

• Interest in or understanding of open-source hardware communities

Why Join Menlo

You will be the person who decides what Asimov looks like to the world. That is a rare brief at this stage of a company, and it comes with the autonomy to match. You will work on a product that is technically ambitious, publicly visible, and genuinely consequential -- with a small team that moves fast and takes the craft seriously.

You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Capco’s Data Team helps our clients transform every aspect of their business. As digital technologies advance and regulations tighten, today’s consumers and today’s businesses are becoming more aware of the importance of good quality data. • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Finance, Mathematics, Operations Research, or a related discipline.

• 10+ years' leading experience and delivering  Data Governance, Data Management, Data Architecture, Data Quality, or Enterprise Data Transformation programs.

• Strong financial services experience across Banking, Wealth Management, Insurance, or Capital Markets .

• Knowledge of industry frameworks such as DCAM , Data Governance Operating Models, Control Frameworks, and Data Lifecycle Management.

• Experience with Data Lineage, Metadata Management, Master Data Management, Data Quality, and Data Architecture .

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Accounts Payable Analyst, your mission is to ensure the integrity, efficiency and continuous improvement of Teya's Accounts Payable function.

You will act as a subject-matter expert across the end-to-end Purchase-to-Pay process, taking ownership of complex AP matters, supplier accounts, payment runs, month-end deliverables and AP controls.

You will work closely with Finance, Procurement, suppliers and wider business teams to resolve issues, improve P2P compliance and strengthen our processes. You will also play a key role in Finance projects, automation initiatives and the continued development of Teya's Finance Shared Services function.

This is a hands-on senior role with significant ownership and influence, where you will be expected to identify problems, challenge existing processes and drive improvements through to implementation.

- Own the payment run process, ensuring completeness, accuracy, appropriate authorisation, fraud controls and execution within agreed timelines.

- Contribute to prioritisation of the AP queue and workload, ensuring urgent, overdue and high-risk items are addressed within agreed service levels.

- Act as a senior point of contact for suppliers and internal stakeholders, handling escalations independently and applying sound commercial judgement.

- Partner with Procurement and business owners to improve P2P compliance, reduce invoice exceptions and strengthen upstream discipline.

- Present findings, risks and recommendations clearly to Finance management and non-Finance stakeholders.

- Support wider Finance Operations activities where required, including intercompany transactions, employee and corporate card reconciliations and expense processes.

Opportunity

•
Work model: Remote / telehealth

•
Schedule: Core hours of 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM Central Time, Monday through Friday

Start: ASAP

Transitional Care Management Visits
